retrieval_timestamp_note: Original downloads occurred on this UTC date; exact per-response receipt timestamps were not logged.

units.WIND_FROM_DEG: degrees clockwise from north, original numeric 1-minute wind direction

processing: Parsed official public table, preserved original HTML byte-for-byte.
Sorted actual minute samples by timestamp and removed 5 identical overlapping hour-boundary records.
Converted KST timestamps to UTC without changing sampling interval.
Retained raw numeric wind direction and 10-minute wind fields in extra columns.
Set WIND_FROM_DEG blank when wind speed is zero; raw published direction remains WIND_FROM_DEG_RAW.
No interpolation, random input, upsampling, pressure reconstruction, or invented observations.
limitations: Public display table has no station pressure or QC flags; absence of flags does not assert full quality control.
Sea-level pressure cannot be used as station pressure, and no independent pressure-reduction validation is possible.
8.13m is station ground elevation, not verified barometer elevation.
Minute wind averages do not provide 10Hz turbulence measurements.
Historical station coordinates are not date-specific verified relocation history.
wind_definition_reference: KMA FAQ Q15: wind direction is where wind comes from; Q16: north0/360 degrees and clockwise east90, west270; minute observations can have0.1degree resolution.
attribution: Source: Korea Meteorological Administration (KMA), Incheonyeonsu AWS512 minute observations,2025-10-01. Downloaded2026-10-22; UTC conversion and calm-direction normalization documented here.
licensing_note: No explicit dataset-specific license badge appears in the downloaded legacy observation tables. The KMA portal copyright policy describes KOGL Type1 for marked KMA-owned works; no specific KOGL designation is asserted for these unmarked tables.
